title: "KNN"
output: html_document
date: "2025-11-15"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set.seed(2025)


# Paquets
library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)

df <- dades_imputades

# 1) Split intern
df_tr <- df %>% filter(Group == "train")
df_te <- df %>% filter(Group == "test")

# 2) Selecció de variables
vars_x <- c("Geography", "Balance", "Age", "IsActiveMember",
            "NumOfProducts", "NetPromoterScore","Gender")
target <- "Exited"

# 3) Preparació i neteja del target
#    Converteixo Exited a factor amb nivells Yes/No (Yes = classe positiva)
df_tr[[target]] <- factor(
  ifelse(as.character(df_tr[[target]]) %in% c("1","Yes","TRUE"), "Yes", "No"),
  levels = c("Yes","No")
)

# 4) One-hot encoding NOMÉS amb el train (per fixar columnes) i aplicar-lo al test
#    (fullRank=TRUE evita col·linearitats perfectes)
dmy <- caret::dummyVars(~ ., data = df_tr[, vars_x, drop = FALSE], fullRank = TRUE)
X_tr <- as.data.frame(predict(dmy, newdata = df_tr[, vars_x, drop = FALSE]))
X_te <- as.data.frame(predict(dmy, newdata = df_te[, vars_x, drop = FALSE]))

# 5) Estandardització amb mitjanes/desviacions del TRAIN (i aplicar al TEST)
pp <- caret::preProcess(X_tr, method = c("center","scale"))
X_tr <- predict(pp, X_tr)
X_te <- predict(pp, X_te)

y_tr <- df_tr[[target]]

# 6) Control d’entrenament (CV, probabilitats, mètrica ROC).

ctrl <- trainControl(
  method          = "repeatedcv",
  number          = 5,
  repeats         = 2,
  classProbs      = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary

)

# 7) Grid de k (imparell per evitar empats). 
k_grid <- data.frame(k = seq(3, 41, 2))

# 8) Entreno KNN optimitzant ROC (  fa la cerca del millor k)
set.seed(2025)
fit_knn <- caret::train(
  x = X_tr, y = y_tr,
  method   = "knn",
  trControl= ctrl,
  metric   = "ROC",
  tuneGrid = k_grid
)


# 9) Prediccions sobre el conjunt Group == "test"
pred_label <- predict(fit_knn, newdata = X_te)
pred_prob  <- predict(fit_knn, newdata = X_te, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]

library(caret)

# Fem una partició interna del train: 70% train, 30% validació
set.seed(123)
idx <- createDataPartition(df_tr[[target]], p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

X_tr_in  <- X_tr[idx, ]
X_val_in <- X_tr[-idx, ]
y_tr_in  <- y_tr[idx]
y_val    <- y_tr[-idx]

# Entrenem només amb el subconjunt de train intern
set.seed(123)
fit_knn_in <- caret::train(
  x = X_tr_in, y = y_tr_in,
  method    = "knn",
  trControl = ctrl,
  metric    = "ROC",
  tuneGrid  = k_grid
)

# Prediccions en la validació interna
pred_val  <- predict(fit_knn_in, newdata = X_val_in)
prob_val  <- predict(fit_knn_in, newdata = X_val_in, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]

cm_val <- confusionMatrix(pred_val, y_val, positive = "Yes")
prec   <- cm_val$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
rec    <- cm_val$byClass["Sensitivity"]
f1_val <- 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec)

auc_val <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(response = y_val,
                                          predictor = prob_val,
                                          levels = c("No","Yes"),
                                          direction = "<")))

cat("\n===== VALIDACIÓ INTERNA AL TRAIN =====\n")
cat("k* (CV):", fit_knn_in$bestTune$k, "\n")
cat("Accuracy:", round(cm_val$overall["Accuracy"], 4), "\n")
cat("Precision:", round(prec, 4), "\n")
cat("Recall   :", round(rec, 4), "\n")
cat("F1       :", round(f1_val, 4), "\n")
cat("AUC      :", round(auc_val, 4), "\n")

# ID per a la submissió
submit <- data.frame(
  ID    = if ("ID" %in% names(df_te)) df_te$ID else seq_len(nrow(df_te)),
  Exited= ifelse(pred_prob >= 0.5, "Yes", "No")
)

write.csv(submit, "knn_submission.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nFitxer guardat: knn_submission.csv\n")

```
